month_theme: Physics HL exam week — then pivot to English

must_do.text: MONDAY APR 27 — Rest day. Light notes review only (max 1 hour). Sleep well. No new papers.
TUESDAY APR 28 — Physics HL Paper 1. Show up, execute, trust your preparation.
WEDNESDAY APR 29 — Physics HL Paper 2. Same mindset. You are ready.
THU-SAT (Apr 30 - May 2) — English A Lang & Lit SL: 2 timed Paper 1 unseen text analyses under exam conditions. Exam is May 7.
THU-SAT (Apr 30 - May 2) — English A Lang & Lit SL: Review Paper 2 comparative essay structure and practiced texts.

should_do.text: Spanish B — Quick sweep of all 5 IO themes. Make a one-page vocab/key points sheet per theme.
Economics SL — Paper 1 essay structure review: intro, body (diagram + explanation + evaluation), conclusion.

could_do.text: Math AA HL — 20-min Paper 3 technique orientation (exam May 14-20, still time to build this up next week)
Take time to decompress after Physics. This was a major milestone.

key_dates.event: English A Lang & Lit SL Paper 1 — 11 days away
English A Lang & Lit SL Paper 2
Math AA HL Paper 3 — final exam

notes: Physics HL is done after Wednesday. From Thursday, English owns the week — you have 8 days to Paper 1 once Physics is over. The pivot has to be immediate and clean. Do not dwell on Physics after Wednesday regardless of how it felt. Spanish and Econ are supporting work this week, not the focus. Math has until May 14 — that gets its own dedicated week starting May 4.
